semantics: Equivalent capabilities and observable behavior; idiomatic APIs and explicit module/permission requirements.

features.resource_policy: Artifact SHA-256 uses incremental reads with at most 64 KiB working input buffers; fingerprint framing, cache record schema and atomic record replacement remain unchanged.

json_feedback_equality.missing: distinct from null; removals emit null
json_feedback_equality.numbers: equal mathematical decimal JSON values regardless of integer/fraction/exponent spelling; preserve distinct representable values without float rounding

transport_limits.input_release: after handler completion or dial batch retirement; independent of dequeue
transport_limits.input_overflow: cancellable backpressure, or explicit disconnect/cancellation when the transport cannot pause
transport_limits.receive_staging_scope: Native readers bound raw receive staging; global JavaScript WebSocket may allocate an oversized raw message before SDK callback rejection. Accepted envelopes are bounded to 1 MiB.

state_limits.accounting: raw file bytes before decoding the required version 1 envelope
state_limits.overflow: Reject before mutation; preserve loaded/saved state and block subsequent writes until explicit successful reload or missing-file reload after moving the protected file. Go Restore returns errors directly. Only current version 1 envelopes are accepted; no raw or migration API.
state_limits.growing_files: enforce the limit on bytes actually read, without relying on initial metadata
state_limits.serialization: Serialize each eligible write attempt once; compare and atomically publish the same encoded bytes. Retain pending dirty state and the previous durable file on failure; preserve each SDK existing format and unchanged-write behavior.
state_limits.missing_paths: Only a genuinely absent file under existing directories or a creatable missing directory tree loads as empty. Ambiguous OS NotFound errors for existing non-directory, inaccessible or dangling paths surface as storage errors and do not clear prior load protection; directory aliases are followed.

inspector_limits.accounting: 2 bytes per retained UTF-16 code unit in scope/id/name/kind, plus 128 bytes per choice and 64 bytes per scope; DOM and browser socket staging are separate
inspector_limits.overflow: Reject oversized incoming results before replacing the current last-good scope; evict least recently used other scope caches to admit valid results
inspector_limits.retention: Keep compact id/name/kind choices only; clearChoices retires an explicit scope; schema ownership is weak

javascript_worker_ownership.admission: Count-based; arbitrary structured-clone values and runtime overhead have no exact retained-byte bound
javascript_worker_ownership.submission: Clone ordinary values once before queueing; preserve SharedArrayBuffer sharing; already-aborted submissions do not clone
javascript_worker_ownership.startup: Transfer reachable ArrayBuffers in the SDK-owned snapshot through enumerable properties, views, Maps and Sets; never detach caller buffers; release parent snapshot after startup
javascript_worker_ownership.isolation: Each job owns a fresh module worker; cancellation retires it; no cross-job reuse
javascript_worker_ownership.opaque_values: Runtime clone behavior remains for opaque host values and nonenumerable properties

host_storage_limits.generation: opaque canonical decimal string, at most 39 digits
host_storage_limits.control_delivery: correlate before normal callbacks; no reentrant handlers; bounded timeout if input backpressure prevents later read

thumbnail_limits.overrides: Per-call positive safe integer input-byte and source-pixel limits; codec allocation restrictions may reject additional inputs. No global mutable limits.
thumbnail_limits.decoding: Full source decoding may retain multiple buffers. Cooperative cancellation; no partial publication.

helper_limits.operation_retirement: Only confirmed/failed, unpinned records from inactive groups; never retry external operations.
